## Overview

## My role

- Conducted site inspections, document reviews and stakeholder interviews
- Assessed environmental, social, governance and HSE compliance risk, benchmarked against ISO, IFC Performance Standards, ADB and AIIB standards
- Produced actionable mitigation reports and action plans that informed the client's investment decision
